title: Shadow Addons
description: Adds shadow-themed blocks, tools, enchantments, dungeons, and custom challenge spawners.
body:
# Shadow Addons

Shadow Addons is a Fabric mod that expands Minecraft with shadow-themed blocks, items, structures, enchantments, and custom challenge spawners.

Explore dark ruins, survive Shadow Spawner encounters, collect shadow materials, and use new tools and enchantments built around a darker Minecraft progression style.

## Features

- Shadow-themed building blocks, including shadow stone, bricks, tiles, pillars, walls, stairs, and slabs.
- Custom Shadow Spawners with different difficulty levels.
- Shadow Sanctum and Shadow Spawner structures for world exploration.
- New utility items like the Shadow Stick, Shadow Eye, Veil Pulse, Faded Page, and more.
- Custom enchantments and curses for movement, combat, and shadow-based effects.
- Loot table integration, particles, sounds, advancements, and redstone-related spawner blocks.

Shadow Addons is designed for players who want more mysterious structures, darker exploration content, and extra shadow-themed tools in their Minecraft world.
